correctness.rationale: Each vertex has exactly three possible centered balls of radii 0,1,2; row-wise linearization leads to all 3^4=81 rational stochastic matrices A_alpha. An independently written rational Gram/minor enumerator verified (29/20)I−A_alpha^T A_alpha positive definite for exactly the 79 nonalternating choices. For the two alternating choices, the exceptional Gram has characteristic factors (t−1)(9t−1)(9t²−14t+1)/81 and unique top eigenvalue Lambda=(7+2sqrt10)/9 with positive eigenvector (1,3+sqrt10,1,3+sqrt10). Comparing actual maximal-ball choices at low/high sites proves equality; other cases have lower spectral bound, so these exhaust equality moduli. The 81-case check is a complete finite certificate for the four-vertex domain.
